title: Conformal radius of Gerver's sofa
words: Map a disc conformally onto Gerver's sofa, sending the centre to the sofa's centroid. Show the scale factor is transcendental.
math: Prove the conformal radius of Gerver's sofa at its centroid is transcendental.

title: Hot spots on Gerver's sofa
words: Heat an insulated plate shaped like Gerver's sofa. Decide whether the hottest point eventually sits on the boundary.
math: Decide whether every second Neumann eigenfunction of Gerver's sofa attains its maximum and minimum only on the boundary.
